name: How much does bathroom door frame repair cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does bathroom door frame repair cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a bathroom door frame generally ranges from $150 to $400 for minor patching and alignment, while full frame replacement typically runs between $350 and $800, including labor and materials. Factors influencing the total price include whether custom casing is needed to match existing trim, if tile removal is required around the jamb, and whether moisture has damaged the wall studs behind the frame. Uncovering hidden mold or framing rot during demolition will increase labor and material requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairs usually cost between $150 and $400 for minor damage, while a full frame replacement generally ranges from $350 to $800 depending on material and underlying water damage.
